name: Brooklands Museum, Weybridge
summary: Brooklands tells the intertwined stories of motor racing and aviation at the world's first purpose-built motor-racing circuit. Displays include racing cars, motorcycles, historic aircraft and Concorde. The London Bus Museum is on the same site and included with standard admission.
reasonToVisit: Motor racing and aviation history, including Concorde, at the world's first purpose-built circuit
planningDetail: The Concorde Experience uses a separate timed ticket: advance booking recommended
